ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Chapters 90:1? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Chapters 90:1 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Selected Chapters 90:1 has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Selected Chapters 90:1 to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Chapters 90:1.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I? (1 mark)
   A. Use Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I.
   D. Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Saum ,? (1 mark)
   A. Say Saum , has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum ,.
   C. Use Saum , to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Saum , with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

5. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Ulumul Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Qur’an.
   D. Say Ulumul Qur’an has no place in daily life.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

7. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends.
   B. Say Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf),? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf),.
   B. Apply the teaching of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Significance of Tawhid? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Significance of Tawhid.
   B. Apply the teaching of Significance of Tawhid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Significance of Tawhid to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Significance of Tawhid has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Use Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Shirk of Shirk Shirk? (1 mark)
   A. Say Shirk of Shirk Shirk has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Shirk of Shirk Shirk.
   C. Apply the teaching of Shirk of Shirk Shirk with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Shirk of Shirk Shirk to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Dimensions of Morality in Islam has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam.
   D. Use Dimensions of Morality in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  has no place in daily life.

   D. Use Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  to insult classmates of other faiths.

14. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

15. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr? (1 mark)
   A. Say Zakat and Zakatul Fitr has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat and Zakatul Fitr.
   C. Use Zakat and Zakatul Fitr to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad 13 Total Number of Lessons 120 Note: The  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
